whatChanges.heading: What we work on together
whatChanges.body: People come to me to move better, build control and feel stronger. This is what we work on in every session.

items.title: Control
items.detail: You learn to move with precision, control and breath.

items.title: Strength and mobility
items.detail: We build both together, at your level.

items.title: Technique
items.detail: You learn each exercise properly, in the order it was designed.

method.heading: What Classical Pilates is, and how private sessions work
method.body: Classical Pilates is the method Joseph Pilates created, kept as he designed it. The original exercises, in a set order, on the apparatus he invented. It is a complete system. Each session builds on the last.

steps.title: We start with you
steps.detail: Your first private session includes a movement assessment and goal setting.

steps.title: I plan your sessions
steps.detail: After the first session I plan what we work on next.

steps.title: I correct your form as you move
steps.detail: In person or on camera, in real time.

steps.title: We adjust week to week
steps.detail: I track your progress and change the plan as you go.

items.title: Beginners to professional athletes

faqHeading: Questions people ask before they start

faqs.question: I'm a complete beginner. Can I start?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every session is tailored to your current level. You will never be thrown into something your body isn't ready for.

faqs.question: How do I book, and what does it cost?
faqs.answer: Prices are not listed on this site. Send me a message through the contact form and tell me what you are interested in. I reply personally, usually within 24 to 48 hours. Then we talk about your goals, scheduling and pricing.

faqs.question: Do I have to be in Boca Raton?
faqs.answer: No. I am based in Boca Raton, Florida and teach in person locally. I also teach online worldwide. Online sessions are live, and I correct your form on camera in real time.

faqs.question: I have an injury or a health condition. Can I still do Pilates?
faqs.answer: Pilates is exercise, not medical care. I don't diagnose or treat anything. Please check with your doctor or physical therapist before you start. Once you have the OK, tell me about it in your message. Private sessions are planned around your body and your history.

faqs.question: Can I come with a partner or a friend?
faqs.answer: Yes. Semi-private sessions are for 2 to 4 people. The sequence is built for the group and scaled for each person, at a shared rate.

faqs.question: How does Classical Pilates help athletes?
faqs.answer: We work on control, alignment and deep stability. These support every other sport. Many athletes also use Pilates for recovery and longevity. I teach professional athletes from tennis, rugby, jiu-jitsu, MMA and golf.

faqs.question: What is Classical Pilates?
faqs.answer: It is the method Joseph Pilates created, which he first called Contrology. Classical Pilates keeps his work as he designed it: the original exercises, the set order, and the apparatus he invented. It is not a random workout or a fusion class.
